description: Every other Route operation takes the `x-ms-client-id` header that Microsoft Entra ID calls must send (the Maps account's unique ID), but the spec omits it on Get Route Operations Status, so an Entra-authenticated client cannot poll its own async matrix. Add the header member.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Indicates the account intended for use with the Microsoft Entra ID security model: the Azure Maps account's unique ID.
